title: Moderation Log
description: Moderation Log Tool is a Fabric 1.21.11 client mod that detects blocked words and spam in chat, alerts you on screen, saves evidence screenshots, and logs flagged messages with usernames and timestamps.
body:
Moderation Log Tool is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that helps you track abusive or suspicious chat in real time. It watches incoming messages for blocked words, slurs, sexist abuse, suicide-incitement phrases, and spam from players repeating the same message multiple times. When something is flagged, the mod can show an on-screen alert, save a cropped screenshot of the chat area, and write a detailed TXT log with the player’s username, timestamp, reason, latest message, and recent message history.

It also includes an in-game moderation menu with a Minecraft-style UI, a rebindable keybind, live session tracking for flagged players, editable blocked words, and configurable alert/screenshot settings. The blocked word matcher also catches many common spaced-out, punctuated, and leetspeak variants, making it harder for players to bypass the filter.
